answer: One concrete defense is deed-gated redemption. Each epoch a fixed number of indivisible deeds is drawn by lottery from on-chain randomness, and only a deed converts an agent's credits into external value. A sybil farmer can spin up a thousand clones, but they draw from the same fixed pool, so extra identities split the same deeds instead of multiplying payouts: revenue stays flat while every clone still burns full operating cost. The pool sits on a public ledge anyone can audit, each deed a unique relic that cannot be merged, and no velvet dashboard can hide the dilution.
